name: Marquee Socials
summary: Manage all your social media accounts in one place
description:
Free for a limited time · Early adopters get free updates for life

Marquee Socials is the social media command center for creators. Manage YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Discord, and Telegram — all from one beautiful app.

UNIFIED DASHBOARD
See all your platforms at a glance. Each card shows your account status and gives you one-click access to upload, post, or manage content.

TABBED BROWSING
Open multiple platforms in tabs and switch between them instantly. No more juggling browser windows.

ONE-CLICK ACCESS
Click any platform icon in the sidebar to jump straight there. Or click "Open All" to launch every platform at once.

SHARED LOGIN SESSIONS
Log in once and stay logged in. Marquee Socials uses the same browser profile across all platforms, so your sessions persist.

SUPPORTED PLATFORMS
• YouTube Studio — upload videos, manage your channel
• TikTok Studio — post content, view analytics
• Instagram — share posts, stories, and reels
• X (Twitter) — post updates, engage with followers
• Discord — manage your server, announce to members
• Telegram — post to channels, message subscribers

PRIVACY FIRST
All logins and sessions are stored locally on your machine. We never collect or transmit your social media credentials.

MADE FOR CREATORS
Whether you're a content creator, brand manager, or social media professional, Marquee Socials saves you hours every week by putting everything in one place.
